# @aponiajs/cli

> The Bun-native command-line interface for AponiaJS: it scaffolds a new project and generates Nest-style schematics inside an existing one.

The published surface is the globally installed `aponia` binary (`bun add --global @aponiajs/cli`). It is independent of the runtime packages and holds the templates the generated applications are rendered from.

## Commands

- [aponia new <name>](../../docs/cli.md): creates a project from the application template, and also installs its dependencies unless `--skip-install` is passed; `--dry-run` reports the planned files without writing.
- [aponia generate <schematic> <name>](../../docs/cli.md): generates one schematic, registering it in the nearest Aponia module unless `--skip-import` is passed.
- [Schematic catalog](../../docs/cli.md): application, library, class, controller, decorator, filter, gateway, guard, interface, interceptor, middleware, module, pipe, provider, resolver, resource, and service, with Nest aliases.
- [aponia g resource <name> --type rest](../../docs/cli.md): REST, GraphQL code-first, GraphQL schema-first, microservice, and WebSocket resource transports; a REST resource also emits validated create, update, and path-parameter models.
- [aponia g gateway <name>](../../docs/cli.md): emits a `@WebSocketGateway()` provider, and a WebSocket CRUD resource emits the create, find-all, find-one, update, and remove message handlers.
- [aponia --version, aponia --help](../../docs/cli.md): print the CLI version or the usage summary.

## What this package exports

The `aponia` binary is the normal entry point. The same behavior is available programmatically:

- [runCli](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/commands/run-cli.ts): runs one command and returns an exit code; it prints `CREATE` and `UPDATE` change lines and never throws.
- [parseArguments](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/commands/arguments.ts): turns an argument vector into a `CliCommand`, rejecting unknown commands, schematics, options, and transports.
- [generateProject](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/generation/project-generator.ts): renders the application template into a new directory.
- [generateSchematic](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/generation/schematic-generator.ts): plans, renders, and registers one schematic.
- [generateSchematics](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/commands/command.constants.ts): the list of supported schematic names.

## Public types

- [CliCommand, GenerateCommandOptions, GenerateSchematic, ResourceTransport](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/commands/command.types.ts): the parsed command contract.
- [GenerateProjectOptions, GenerateProjectResult](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/generation/project-generator.types.ts): project scaffolding inputs and result.
- [GenerateSchematicOptions, GenerateSchematicResult, SchematicChange](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/cli/src/generation/schematic.types.ts): schematic inputs, result, and the per-file change record.
